history.summary: A new (2028 TOP) 99-yr leasehold 4BR in Pasir Ris at $1.95M / $1,614 psf, 1km+ from Pasir Ris MRT. The price sits inside the deep-liquidity band and D18 benefits from CRL + Pasir Ris transformation, but a 4BR niche unit, an over-1km MRT walk and no project-specific URA data keep this a middling hold.
history.rating_rationale: $1,614 psf for a brand-new 99-yr LH 4BR (1,206 sqft) in OCR D18 is fair, not cheap. No project URA series (regional-baseline fallback), score_1000 519 and a near-even 229-187 arena record. 12-min/1.03km walk to Pasir Ris MRT undercuts the transit case; 4BR is a family-only, narrower buyer pool.
red_flags: No project-specific URA appreciation data — regional-baseline fallback
1.03km / 12-min walk to Pasir Ris MRT is not a transit-premium location
4BR is a niche family-only segment with a narrower buyer pool
New OCR leasehold — appreciation not yet resale-proven
catalysts: Cross Island Line + Pasir Ris bus interchange/mall redevelopment in D18
Brand-new 2028 TOP unit at a sub-$2M entry within the liquid band
Pasir Ris coastal/Downtown East lifestyle appeal for families
